verdict.rationale: The axis applies because a skill collection could plausibly ship a skill-authoring meta-skill, but the evidence shows none. The documented skills cover TDD, grilling, triage, specs, debugging, repo setup and a skill router ('Find out which skill to use'), and none guides an agent through writing, improving or packaging new skills. Editable installed files and the community remark about learning from reading the skills are user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection ships a meta-skill or tool that guides my agent through writing, improving, and packaging new skills
